name: io.github.synopsys0/postfader-fl-studio-mcp
title: Postfader
description: Read-back-verified mixer and plug-in control for FL Studio 2026 on macOS, with audio analysis.

environmentVariables.name: FL_BRIDGE_ENABLE_MIDI
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to build the MIDI SysEx transport. Without it the server cannot reach FL Studio.

environmentVariables.name: FL_STUDIO_USER_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: FL Studio's user-data folder, if it is not ~/Documents/Image-Line/FL Studio.
